scope: Whole training-label-vector permutations, only within each of nine saved 128-object fitting folds
joint_attributes: Same permutation index used across all attributes within a fold
preserved: Features, bandwidths, kernel/support/shrinkage, global label mean, active labels, KL normalizer, label-vector rows and row-internal probabilities
statistics: Primary descriptive fold score: average W over sources and all attributes. Secondary: each attribute average W against its own permutation background
q95_scope: Above own permutation 95th percentile is descriptive; not a multiplicity-adjusted significant-attribute count
p_scope: One-sided finite-permutation rank (1+exceedances)/200 for each fold, conditional on label-row exchangeability under the null. No independence between overlapping folds or combined dataset p-value claimed.
